name: Southerly freshening
story: A fine morning gives way to a changing afternoon: a southerly breeze freshening, a milky veil of altostratus sliding over from the southwest, the barometer falling steadily. Fly in the morning; the front comes tomorrow.
forecast: Fair morning, high cloud thickening from 13:00. South 6 kt, 11-12 kt by evening. Pressure falling. STORM tomorrow: a front with a southeast gale and rain, no flying from dawn to 18:00.
